meta.title: Cat Go! - Help Ginger get the Golden Tuna back
meta.description: Cat Go! is a free Android lane battler. Ginger napped on guard duty. The Golden Tuna was stolen. Switch lanes, stack weapons and beat bosses over 60 chapters.

hero.h1: Help Ginger get his Golden Tuna back.
hero.sub: Ginger had one job: guard the Golden Tuna. He took a nap. The Ogre King stole it. Help Ginger chase him through six worlds, past lots of goblins and at least one very big snowball.

story.title: It all started with a nap
story.sub: Every new world opens with a short comic. This is the first one.

climb.title: From power 1 to 20K
climb.sub: Everything Ginger picks up or eats changes his power. He'll need plenty for the boss.

steps.title: Sets off
steps.note: Ginger leaves home with just 1 power.

steps.title: Goblin camp
steps.note: He eats the whole camp and takes their power.

steps.title: Poop card
steps.note: Wrong lane: poop halves his power.

steps.title: Pig mount
steps.label: 3K
steps.note: A pig mount multiplies his power.

steps.title: Pet joins
steps.label: 3.5K
steps.note: A lizard tags along and fights too.

steps.title: Brute
steps.label: 8.5K
steps.note: The brute is bigger than him. The daggers fix that.

climb.label: Ginger plays a chapter of Whisker Woods on his own: he takes a dagger card, eats a goblin camp, picks up a poop card, eats three skeletons, rides a pig, gets a lizard pet, beats a brute and then the Ogre King.

steps.title: You pick the lane
steps.text: Tap to switch. That's the only control. Ginger runs and throws on his own.

steps.title: Ginger eats their power
steps.text: Knock an enemy's number down to zero. Ginger takes all its power. Bigger number, bigger cat.

steps.title: Every card stacks
steps.text: Daggers, crossbow bolts, sword waves, homing orbs, fire. Grab a good card. Leave the poop card.

steps.title: Then the boss
steps.text: Every chapter ends with a boss. Halfway there you pick one of three power-ups.

worlds.title: Where the Tuna went
worlds.sub: Six worlds, each with its own enemies and pet. Whoever's at the end won't hand things over nicely.

items.name: Whisker Woods
items.text: Goblin camps, skeletons and Ogre Keep. The Ogre King has the Tuna. Or he did.

items.name: Volcano Lands
items.text: "Tuna? Oh... I traded it to the Dragon Queen." So it's off across the lava.

items.name: Dragon Realm
items.text: The terrible Dragon Queen is a baby who just wanted a friend.

items.name: Frostpaw Peaks
items.text: The Yeti King keeps the Golden Ice Cream and throws very big snowballs. When a lane glows, move.

items.name: Desert Dunes
items.text: The Sphinx King guards the Golden Cookie. Answer his riddle or meet his Mummy Golem.

items.name: Sunken Reef
items.text: The Crab King pinches everything. His Kraken's currents push Ginger out of his lane.

heroes.title: Pick your cat
heroes.sub: Ginger isn't the only cat who can make the trip. Play as eight more cats, each with a perk. Four start every run with a weapon.

weapons.title: The weapons pile up
weapons.sub: Pick up a dagger, then a crossbow, then a sword. They all keep firing. Each world adds something new: bombs, boomerangs, ice wands, a sandstorm, a trident.

pets.title: A pet for the road
pets.sub: Each world has its own pet card. Grab it and the pet fights beside Ginger. Find three of the same pet and it evolves.

style.title: Ginger's wardrobe
style.sub: Hats, capes, wings, weapon skins and trails from the Style shop. Yes, he can throw a fish.

items.title: Endless
items.text: No boss, no finish line. See how big Ginger gets before something bigger shows up.

items.title: Daily challenge
items.text: One new run every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going.

items.title: Leaderboards
items.text: Sign in to Google Play Games to put your Endless and daily scores on the leaderboards.

event.title: Pumpkins on the road, 24-31 October
event.text: Pumpkin enemies, a Pumpkin King and candy to collect. Ginger gets a witch hat and bat wings.

what.title: What is Cat Go!?
body: Cat Go! is a mobile game about a cat on a road with two or three lanes. Every enemy has a number. Knock out a smaller one and its number is added to yours. Run into a bigger one and the run ends.
It's made by XO Productions, a small independent studio. Cat Go! is free on Google Play and plays offline.

items.q: What kind of game is Cat Go!?
items.a: Cat Go! is a lane-running battler. Ginger runs by himself on a road with two or three lanes. You tap to switch lanes. Beat enemies with a smaller power number to take their power. Avoid bigger ones.

items.q: What is the story of Cat Go!?
items.a: Ginger fell asleep guarding the legendary Golden Tuna, and the Ogre King stole it. Chase him through six worlds to a Dragon Queen, then more Golden Treats guarded by the Yeti King, the Sphinx King and the Crab King.
Yes, Cat Go! is free to download and play. Optional ads let you revive or double your coins by watching a video. You can also buy coin packs, premium heroes or a monthly VIP pass.

items.q: Can I play Cat Go! offline?
items.a: Yes, the whole campaign works offline. Ads, purchases and leaderboards need an internet connection.
No, Cat Go! is only on Android through Google Play for now.
There are 60 chapters across six worlds, with a boss at the end of each chapter. Endless mode unlocks after chapter 10. The daily challenge unlocks after chapter 3.
Collect three of the same pet to evolve it into a stronger form. Pick up a pet card in a world and the pet joins your run.
Yes, the No Ads purchase or VIP pass removes ads between runs. Rewarded videos stay optional: you only see them if you choose to.
XO Productions (XO Labs), a small indie studio, makes it. Email xo.labs.production@gmail.com.

cta.title: The Tuna won't rescue itself
cta.text: Ginger's ready when you are. Cat Go! is free on Google Play.
